headline: Introducing GlowberryClient
summary: The launcher is now GlowberryClient, with a rebuilt interface, a new Installations tab for one-tap Bedrock installs, and three PvP combat modules.

items.text: Chimera Launcher is now GlowberryClient, with a new name, package and app identity.
A new Installations tab lists the Bedrock versions a mirror publishes and installs a chosen one as its own instance.
A failed install keeps the downloaded package so you can retry without downloading it again.
The Mod Menu gains a PvP tab that groups Aim Settings, CPS Display and Snaplook together.
Armor HUD shows durability and enchantments for you and your target; Crystal Optimizer highlights the best crystal placement; Hit Registration smooths your look input.
A new violet brand palette, a shared card style, a refreshed splash screen and a new app icon.
The original top navigation bar is back, so all six tabs stay reachable.
